newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daehan Flour seeks 22,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Daehan Flour seeks 22,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd has invited tenders to buy 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday, traders said on Wednesday.

Traders said the total amount would be split into four postions -- 8,500 tonnes of western white/soft white, 4,000 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 11.5 percent), 1,000 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 13.5 percent) and 8,500 tonnes of dark northern spring (protein minimum 14 percent).
Shipment was set for June 20-July 20 to the western port of Inchon.
